Who among the following introduced the Blue Water Policy?
Blue Water Policy is associated with
x:
The Blue Water Policy (Política da Água Azul) was introduced by the Portuguese Viceroy Francisco de Almeida, the first Portuguese Viceroy in India. The main objective of this policy was to establish Portuguese naval supremacy in the Indian Ocean rather than acquiring extensive inland territories. Almeida believed that control over the sea routes would enable Portugal to dominate the lucrative spice trade between Europe and Asia. To implement this policy, the Portuguese developed a strong navy, built coastal forts and attempted to eliminate Arab and other European competitors from maritime trade. Although Almeida emphasized naval supremacy, his successor Afonso de Albuquerque shifted Portuguese policy towards territorial expansion by capturing Goa, Malacca and Hormuz.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (1).
n: Blue Water Policy – Francisco de Almeida
Aim – Control of Indian Ocean trade
